subject.title: fix(agents): carry provenance through active subagent wakes

question: Should the rebased fix add active wake provenance through the current queued transcript-recorder path, or keep the PR's older public `AgentSession.steer` options overload?
rationale: The useful behavior is clear, but current `main` has since introduced a different queued user-turn persistence API, and the PR also changes public plugin SDK surface.

options.title: Use current recorder path
options.body: Rebase the fix so active wake provenance rides the existing queue/transcript option path without adding a stale public steering overload.

options.title: Keep a public steer options overload
options.body: Accept the API expansion and update current recorder callers/tests around that new public contract before merge.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Leave the PR open but unmerged until an owner decides whether the API shape is still worth carrying forward.

recommendation.title: Use current recorder path
recommendation.body: Rebase the fix so active wake provenance rides the existing queue/transcript option path without adding a stale public steering overload.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and PR metadata point to `steipete` as the most recent owner of the queue/steering API surfaces that now conflict with the PR shape.
